title: BlueFive Capital appoints Marwan Elaraby as MENA president
summary: Elaraby brings more than two decades of legal and corporate experience
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
Hazem Ben-Gacem, Founder and Chief Executive of BlueFive Capital. Image Courtesy: BlueFive Capital

Elaraby brings more than two decades of legal and corporate experience

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

BlueFive Capital, an Abu Dhabi-based global investment platform, has appointed Marwan Elaraby as President for the MENA region.
